baseline.text:
ROOT_CAUSE: The issue might be due to the terrain being parented to the hero, causing it to move with the hero when it is moved or rotated.

FIX: 
1. Select the terrain node in the scene tree.
2. Right-click and un-parent the terrain from the hero node.
3. Re-parent the terrain to the root node of the scene (usually the "World" node).

This fix will ensure the terrain remains static while the hero can be moved or rotated.

ROOT_CAUSE: The world/terrain generator node is parented under the hero node, causing any transform change on the hero to affect the entire subtree, including the world.

FIX: Remove the parent-child relationship between the world/terrain generator node and the hero node. Ensure the world/terrain generator is not a child of the hero node. This will prevent the terrain/world from moving when the hero is moved or rotated.
